EmailTemplate.name: Randy Crawford - Upcoming ONLINE Session Reminder
EmailTemplate.subject: Join an online info session for Mary Lou Fulton Teachers College
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
I just wanted to remind you that we have our next [Masters without Arizona teacher certification] Graduate Information Session coming up [this week/next week].
This will be an online information session, and takes place tomorrow, [Tuesday, September 16th, from 5:30pm-7:30pm]. This is the best way for you to gather important information about the program, and ensure you get your questions answered.
Please take the time to register for this event and reserve a spot for yourself.
I look forward to having you join the session. If you have any questions or concerns please feel free to contact me!
Kindest regards,
Donna Parris Student Outreach Coordinator Arizona State University | Mary Lou Fulton Teachers College donna.parris@asu.edu 480.727.1745
